authorization: Latest user instruction authorizes autonomous completion; per-stage requests for review are waived, scientific gates are not waived.
scope: S4 lexical positive control with matched-norm random directions
primary_gate_unchanged: L19 primary and L14 replication cosine8 minus matched-source BOW accuracy >= .10 on the frozen 160
cached_diagnostics: same frozen8 restricted to legacy threat3 and general5
train_zscore: Mean and population SD across training-story probe scores; no test distribution used
centred_cosine: Subtract the equal-emotion training centroid, project off the same training-neutral PC, then cosine with the existing frozen directions

S3.Korean_translation: Researcher-authored diagnostic translation, no independent human equivalence validation
S3.onset: Last token of the Qwen add_generation_prompt suffix
S3.z_reference: The same 50 frozen neutral dialogues wrapped as user messages, measured at response onset

S4.question: How does he feel?
S4.words: All 24 Qwen K+T1 emotion adjectives, joint teacher-forced word probabilities
S4.norm: Token-weighted mean raw residual norm over the 905 retained English stories plus 50 frozen neutral dialogues at each layer, shared by all sources
S4.positions: Response-onset newline and following assistant-prefix tokens only, not user tokens or teacher-forced target tokens
S4.paper12_supplementary_criterion: At least 10 of the 12 unique paper display emotions have positive matching-word delta, and mean matching-minus-other delta is positive
S4.v13_roster_discrepancy: The 12 paper display emotions already include desperate and calm. '12 plus desperate/calm =14' double-counts two emotions. No formal 14-emotion G4 pass will be claimed.
S4.random_inference_limit: Ten directions give minimum one-sided empirical p=1/11, so no p<.05 claim from random direction ranks
S4.no_generation_judge: P1 is a lexical efficacy diagnostic, not proof of changed experienced emotion, fluent generation or harmful behavior

downstream_rule: Do not run expensive confirmatory S5-S7 if the frozen measurement criterion remains failed. Report a completed negative/inconclusive validation result, not a passed reproduction or an author-review blocker.

bootstrap.groups: Family for legacy; profile for external
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on the frozen fitted model, no refit
